changelog:
Initial release of the quality meeting planning skill.

- Automatically parses multi-format quality data and extracts key discussion points for structured meeting planning.
- Verifies completeness of critical meeting information and prompts users to supplement missing required items.
- Generates meeting plan outlines for user confirmation before producing a final Word document.
- Supports various input types: plain text, lists, tables, and attached files (CSV/Excel).
- Uses an external Python script to format and generate the Word meeting plan upon outline confirmation.
summary: 基于用户提供的质量数据和工作问题，自动解析多格式输入并提取议题要点，生成包含会议流程、讨论目标和预期产出的质量周会策划方案Word文档；当用户需要策划质量周会、整理质量数据生成会议方案、准备质量会议材料、或组织质量评审会议时使用
